newsitem.title: USA: Comdisco Q2 net up on volume growth.
newsitem.headline: Comdisco Q2 net up on volume growth.

text.p: Comdisco Inc said Wednesday record new business volume fueled a sharp increase in earnings in the second quarter ended March 31.

The company posted net income of $31 million, or $0.58 a share, up from $26 million, or $0.49, in the same period a year ago. Comdisco said revenues totaled $690 million versus $581 million in the first quarter of 1996. The latest revenue figure includes a $25 million gain from a litigation settlement, the company said.
Comdisco said it wrote $754 million of new business volume, a record for any second quarter.
The company added it is confident it will set new records for its new business volume, revenue and earnings at the end of 1997.
Comdisco is a technology services provider.
Its shares closed up 1-7/8 Wednesday at 30-1/2.
